title: Temperature and Molecular Kinetic Energy
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Temperature vs particle motion data/model investigation using particle diagrams and temperature/kinetic energy data. No physical heating is required.

directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the screen that shows particles for solid, liquid, and gas behavior. Record a three-row table with state, particle spacing, particle motion, temperature or energy change, and the phase-change conclusion.
